description:
Issue a Brazilian fiscal document: NFS-e or NF-e.

This produces a legal fiscal document. Confirm the data with the
user before calling when you inferred any field.

Send unit_price with quantity when the user quotes a price per
unit, amount when they quote the line. Sending both asserts they
agree and is refused if they do not.

nfse is a service invoice: the address is optional and
service_code (LC 116/2003 item.subitem) falls back to the
company's fiscal profile. nfe is for goods, and the SEFAZ rejects
a partial one: ncm and cfop on every item and the full
recipient_address. Call validate_invoice_payload first when any of
that was inferred rather than given.

A complementary, adjustment or return NF-e sets purpose and names
the original in referenced_keys; a return the company receives
back sets direction in. An export has recipient_address state EX
with country_code, the export group, and foreign_id when the
buyer has a passport.

Look the recipient up with list_clients first and pass its id as
client_id. A new recipient is saved as a client after a
successful issuance.

Pass idempotency_key when a retry is possible: the same key with
the same payload replays the first answer instead of issuing a
second document. Without one, a retry after a lost response
issues again, burning another credit and number that only a
cancellation within its deadline undoes. One key per business
event, not per call; nothing generates it for you.

client_id.description: A saved client's id, from list_clients: its name, document and address fill whatever this call leaves out. Without it, client_name and tax_id are required.

client_name.description: Recipient's name. Required unless client_id is sent.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

direction.description: out for an outgoing NF-e (CFOP 5/6/7); in for one the company issues for goods coming in, such as a sale the buyer returned (CFOP 1/2/3). nfe only; omitted means out.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

export.description: Where the goods leave Brazil (exporta): exit_state (UF) and place, e.g. Porto de Santos. Required for an nfe to a buyer abroad (recipient_address.state EX), refused otherwise.

exit_state.description: UFSaidaPais: the Brazilian state the goods leave from.

place.description: xLocExporta: place of shipment or border crossing.

external_reference.description: The caller's own id for this document, such as an order number. Stored as sent and returned on every read.

foreign_id.description: Passport or other document of a buyer abroad, used when recipient_address.state is EX. nfe only; may be omitted.

idempotency_key.description: One per business event, e.g. order-1042. Sent as an HTTP header: printable ASCII up to 255, no leading or trailing space.

items.description: One entry per line. Each needs a description and a price: unit_price with quantity, or amount for the whole line. nfe also needs ncm (8 digits) and cfop (4 digits) on every item; nfse may carry service_code. Example: {"description": "Cadeira de escritorio", "unit_price": 225, "quantity": 2, "ncm": "94013000", "cfop": "5102"}. The tax, fuel and ibs_cbs groups in full: the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

barcode.description: cEAN: a GTIN-8/12/13/14, or SEM GTIN.

fuel.description: The NF-e fuel group (comb), needed for a fuel CFOP: anp_code (9 digits), anp_description and consumer_state, plus optional GLP percentages. Full shape in the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

ibs_cbs.description: The Reforma Tributaria group (IBS/CBS) for the item, computed: cst (3 digits), classification (cClassTrib, 6 digits), rate_state, rate_city and rate_federal; base, reduction_ibs and reduction_cbs when they apply. Full shape in the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

ncm.description: The full 8 digits, or 00 for a service line. Any other short code the SEFAZ rejects with 777.

items.description: A presumed tax credit applied to this item.

recopi_number.description: nRECOPI: 20 digits, the last two modulo-11 check digits.

tax.description: The item's taxes, already computed: icms, icms_uf_dest, ipi, pis, pis_st, cofins, cofins_st and v_tot_trib, each ICMS variant chosen by its cst or csosn. Leave it out unless the user gave the computed values. Validated against the SDK model; full shape in the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

tax_retained.description: ISSQN retained by the tomador, nfse only.

number.description: Document number (número), e.g. 1532. Omitted means the next one from the company's counter; set it only to fill a known gap.

purpose.description: Why the NF-e is issued (finNFe): normal, complementary, adjustment or return of goods. nfe only; omitted means normal.

recipient_address.description: The recipient's address. Required for nfe with street, number, neighborhood, city, state (UF, e.g. SP), zip_code (8 digits) and city_code (7-digit IBGE code, e.g. 3550308); optional for nfse. A buyer abroad has state EX and a country_code. With client_id, omit it to use the saved one.

country_code.description: BACEN country code, 1 to 4 digits. Required, and not 1058, when state is EX. Its check digit is not verified: the official table has countries whose digit does not close.

state_registration.description: Recipient's IE (inscrição estadual), NF-e only. Send it for a recipient registered as an ICMS contributor; ISENTO for an exempt one; leave it out for a non-contributor.

referenced_keys.description: Access keys of the NF-e this one refers to: the note being returned, complemented or adjusted. Required for complementary (exactly one) and for most returns. nfe only.

series.description: Document series (série), e.g. 1. Omitted means the company's default series.

tax_id.description: Recipient's CPF or CNPJ. Required unless client_id is sent.

update_client.description: Save the recipient data sent in this call back onto the client named by client_id.

name: issue_invoice

outputSchema.description: One document, as the fiscal API describes it.

access_key.description: The authorizer's key. Absent while the document is not authorized.

id.description: Local id. Use it for reissue and for submissions, and when a document was rejected and has no key.
